exceptions.provenance: Sec. 24. 3. intentionally_added.provenance: Sec. 8.5. 'Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' means Class B firefighting foam containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances that is designed to include at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom that is fully functional in the foam.
